correctness.rationale: Exact fixed-origin deletion conditioning preserves a uniform smaller map. Conditional Cayley forest counting yields all falling moments of origin count, hence the full PGF, and direct difference factorization proves strict antitonicity. Gaussian-product tail bound for cyclic-core law ensures Rayleigh weak convergence and bounded moments; a uniform 1+k²/(2n) control permits expectation passage to the explicit square-root covariance constant. Standalone exhaustive n<=7 calculations and 1086 checks corroborate critical edge cases and formulas.

value.rationale: Origins quantify local indegree sparsity; cyclic-core size quantifies global functional-graph recurrence. Their complete conditioned distribution, strict regression sign, and nontrivial second-order dependence profile answer a natural global-local correlation problem not settled by marginals; the Rayleigh-scale quadratic dependence explains why correlation vanishes despite order-sqrt(n) covariance.
